This is my participation B Post

Joseph Berry

CS182 HW1 Google Colab With Gemini

 Google Gemini was able to easily complete this assignment. It wrote code that was slightly more rudimentary than the staff solution, it was missing an if (i == 0) statement.



Me:

Can you please read through my code and fill in the section of runGDM() that needs to be implemented?

Gemini:

Sure, I can help you with that! I'll add the code to implement gradient descent with momentum in the runGDM function.

Code Gemini Added:
 smoothed_grad = beta * smoothed_grad + (1 - beta) * grad

Me:

What if i == 0? Can you add a check for that? Only modify in between the ### lines

Gemini:

You are correct. I will add an explicit check for i == 0 within the runGDM function.

Code Gemini Added:
 if i == 0:

 smoothed_grad = grad

 else:

 smoothed_grad = beta * smoothed_grad + (1 - beta) * grad

Me:

Now can you complete the code section under Question 2: text section? Fill in that code with one of the methods used in this notebook and give it a different learning rate.

Gemini:

I will add code to the cell under Question 2 to run gradient descent with momentum using a different learning rate and compare it with the results from plain gradient descent.

Code Gemini Added:
 stepsize_new = 2e-4 # Increase the learning rate slightly

grads_m_new, ws_m_new, losses_m_new = runGDM(maxiter, stepsize_new, beta)
